location.basis: Wikidata coordinates for the archaeological site (Q63358276: 23.94626 N, 69.76704 E), about 1.3 km east of the hamlet of Juni Kuran in OpenStreetMap (23.94421 N, 69.75402 E). Neither position, nor a 2 km overview around them at zoom 17, shows an identifiable fortified mound, so the location is not confirmed.

sources.citation_or_service: Esri World Imagery tile service, https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}; Source: Esri, Vantor, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community
sources.north_label_text: Web Mercator grid north (true north at every point; north up)
sources.role_in_measurement: inspected (current World Imagery, around the Wikidata position)

main_system_reason: No Harappan line could be identified in the imagery.
notes: Optional town. The ground around the published positions is scrub, gullies and small fields with tracks; we could not identify the fortified citadel or any straight wall, so we did not measure the site and do not confirm its location.
